item.title: Personal Portfolio
item.description: Designed and maintain a Hugo and PaperMod portfolio with structured project content, search, embedded media, résumé delivery, and automated GitHub Pages deployment.

item.title: Applied Data Science Capstone – SpaceX Launch Analysis
item.description: Built an end-to-end SpaceX launch-analysis pipeline using Python, APIs, web-derived data, SQL, machine learning, maps, and interactive dashboards.

item.title: Cosmic Universalism Computational Intelligence Initiative (CUCII)
item.description: Founded and lead CUCII, an Astro and TypeScript platform featuring a local Prompt Studio, Cosmic Breath Explorer, CU-Time tools, research boundaries, automated testing, and GitHub Pages deployment.

item.title: Secure Access Management System
item.description: Built a Ruby on Rails application with role-based access control, protected resources, cloud-backed uploads, automated testing, and accessibility-focused interfaces.

item.title: Auraria Mobile Parking (AMP) – Team Project
item.description: Served as technical lead for a six-person Kotlin Android project integrating parking, mapping, weather, event, and user-support features.
